Global robustness score: total distance to boundary

bl_robustness.Rd

Returns per-variable and overall total absolute standardised distances to the decision boundary across all observations. A larger value indicates the population is, on average, further from the boundary.

Usage

bl_robustness(bl_boundary, distance = c("mahalanobis", "euclidean"))

Arguments

bl_boundary

A "bl_boundary" object from bl_find_boundary().

distance

Character; per-feature standardisation metric. One of "mahalanobis" (default; uses sqrt(diag(W)) from bl_result$metric) or "euclidean" (legacy; uses X_sd). See plot.bl_boundary() for full details.

Value

Named list with:

sum_of_distance

Named numeric vector; per-variable totals.

robustness

Numeric scalar; sum(sum_of_distance).

distance

Character; the metric used.
